legal.label: Privacy
legal.title: Privacy
paragraphs: This website has no database of its own for the data entered in the contact form.

When you submit the form, your name, email and message are received through the forms service of Netlify, which hosts the website, and forwarded to our inbox (cpinsai02@gmail.com). We use them only to reply to you.
For any request about your data you can contact us at +39 339 427 7111.

legal.label: Cookies
legal.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use cookies, neither technical nor profiling ones, and does not include third-party tracking tools.
Fonts are served directly by the website, with no requests to external services.
